events::Event

One thing that happened during a run.

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub enum Event {
    /// The run started.
    Started {
        /// The run that produced the event, as the scheduler names it in every log line.
        execution: String,
    },

    Stopped {
        /// The run that produced the event, as the scheduler names it in every log line.
        execution: String,

        code: i32,
    },

    Moved {
        /// The run that produced the event, as the scheduler names it in every log line.
        execution: String,

        from: u32,
        to: u32,
    },
}

impl Event {
    /// Returns the run that produced the event.
    pub fn execution(&self) -> &str;
}

Declares the event enum and its accessor: every variant carries execution first, then its own fields.
